name: OmAiry
author: Tiedeyez
description: A small winged Omarchy mark that lives on your desktop. The Omarchy icon is its body, with block wings that flap and a block-art glow that echoes outward in your theme's accent colour. It flies in long lazy arcs, sometimes turning a loop, visits whichever window you are working in and perches on top of it to rest. Click it and it teaches you something about Omarchy, a keybinding or a command, in a card styled like Omarchy's own popups. Starts no processes, touches no files and makes no network requests; it hides under fullscreen windows and holds still when animations are turned off.
